findings.title: page_count is written during ingest but no repository method writes it
findings.problem: A.2 says page_count is stored on course_material at ingest, but updateStatus(id,status,error) never touches page_count and create sets it null at upload. Nothing in the flow persists the parsed page/slide count that C.2 and A.2 step 3 depend on.
findings.fix: Add a repo method (e.g. setPageCount(id,pageCount)) or extend updateStatus to carry pageCount, called inside the step-7 transaction; name it in the courseMaterialRepository modify bullet.

findings.title: Non-null subject_id invariant assumed but DB column is nullable and not owned
findings.where: A.2 step 1; Finding-3 threading; Invariant ownership
findings.problem: The design states a course_material always has a subject_id, but 006 declares subject_id nullable and create passes subjectId ?? null. The invariant rests only on upload validation that the design describes but does not nominate as the enforcement owner; the whole subject_id-threading argument inherits this.
findings.fix: In A.1 state the exact rule (subjectId absent/non-integer/<=0 -> 400 before any write) and add 'course_material.subject_id non-null — owned by materialService upload validation (DB column is nullable)' to Invariant ownership; optionally SET NOT NULL in 013 only if no legacy NULL rows.

findings.title: countCitingQuestions SQL unspecified; correctness depends on non-null chunk_id
findings.problem: The DELETE grounding guard counts question_source_ref rows citing this material's chunks, but the SQL is unspecified and question_source_ref.chunk_id is nullable with no FK delete rule. A naive LEFT JOIN / IS NOT DISTINCT FROM variant would behave differently.
findings.fix: Pin the query: COUNT(*) with an INNER JOIN material_chunk ON mc.material_chunk_id = qsr.chunk_id WHERE mc.material_id = $1, and note the JOIN intentionally ignores NULL chunk_id rows.

findings.title: Citation-in-scope invariant is implicit, not asserted
findings.where: B.5 step 2; B.2 steps 3-4; Invariant ownership
findings.problem: Grounding only checks citation chunk_id is a key in R; it never cross-checks the stored question_source_ref.chunk_id belongs to the job's subject. Safe today only because R is built from in-scope materialIds, but the invariant is implicit and silently weakens if R construction ever changes.
findings.fix: State in B.5 step 2 that R's keys are by construction chunks of the job's in-scope materialIds, so 'in R' transitively means in-scope, and write the invariant 'a persisted question_source_ref.chunk_id is always a chunk of one of the job's validated materials'.

findings.title: Real S3 branch must import DeleteObjectCommand
findings.problem: awsClients.js currently imports only PutObjectCommand and GetObjectCommand; A.4 adds a deleteObject method using DeleteObjectCommand but never notes the import must grow.
findings.fix: Add 'import DeleteObjectCommand from @aws-sdk/client-s3' to the A.4 real-branch description and the files-to-modify bullet.

findings.title: approveBatch all-or-nothing transaction threading unspecified
findings.problem: approveBatch claims a single all-or-nothing transaction while reusing questionService.approve, but approve issues separate awaited queries on the default db with no transaction-client seam, so the atomicity guarantee is aspirational.
findings.fix: Specify that approveBatch does not call per-item approve but runs set-rubric + assertTransition + updateStatusFields for every id inside one db.withTransaction(tx => ...), threading tx to the repository calls (repo methods accept an optional client).
